experiment: Single MultiCamWarp synthetic-sample optimizer step applied to official DD camera encoder+DiT LoRA, native inference on real case15 C 17-frame hardcase. Same effective media, Stage2 endpoint, prompt and initial noise as official baseline; checkpoint only changed.
holistic_visual_review: All 17 native adapter frames inspected against source and official baseline. Output remains very close to official (mean decoded RGB MAE 0.379/255), progressively loses person contrast and detail, and fails to reproduce source right-arm sweep. Slight extra wrist movement is not a whole-action gain; limb motion error worsens 0.484 to 0.634 body units. No scene or camera quality breakthrough.
caveat: One synthetic scene and one optimizer step cannot establish training benefit or generalization; inspect all 17 frames and use held-out multi-scene training before judging adapter direction.
training_conclusion: Training-to-inference adapter path works and the checkpoint affects output, but one synthetic scene/one step does not improve this real Stage3 hardcase. Multi-scene, fixed-target-view data and held-out validation remain necessary.
